name: When should I consider replacing my deck boards?
description: Replace deck boards when they show significant rot, splintering, large cracks, or instability. Regular inspections can help identify issues early.

mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing my deck boards?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing your deck boards when they show signs of significant wear, such as widespread rot, splintering, large cracks, or persistent mold and mildew that cannot be cleaned. Boards that feel springy or unstable underfoot also indicate a need for replacement. Regular inspections, especially after winter, can help identify these issues early. Addressing these problems promptly prevents further damage and ensures the safety of your deck structure.
